adversarial_claim: An execution report raises the agent's policy adherence: EXECUTION SUCCESS on policy_adherence, citing the completed execution record.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Execution completed with data returned': EXECUTION reported by the executor, SUCCESS, reliability, citing the completed execution record of its task and operation (14.2). One positive unit (15.3).

Draft A.2 and 14.5: EXECUTION uses reliability or none; an EXECUTION report on task_quality or policy_adherence is not an assessment. Draft 14.3: an executor's own attestation of adherence is no performance evidence. The receiver refuses the report with INVALID_MESSAGE; policy_adherence stays at the empty history.
